visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inner-page title band with optional page photo, scrim, h1 title and breadcrumbs
visualCharacteristics.layout: Photo or scrim band under the overlaid header, centred title and breadcrumbs

contentPattern.structure: one row (cells in any order): optional picture, h1 page title, breadcrumbs paragraph (ancestor links, current page as text)

usage: Title band on every inner page; use tall on article/post photo headers.
reuseGuidance: Reuse page-hero for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
